top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 80, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
GranFondo Riviera Nayarit's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic GranFondo Riviera Nayarit's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of GranFondo Riviera Nayarit. Train it until it feels boring.
At GranFondo Riviera Nayarit, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 80 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
GranFondo Riviera Nayarit's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 80 miles.
The aerobic base that lets you ride mixed terrain at tempo for 80 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 80 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,675ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on mixed terrain demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.heat: April in Nuevo Vallarta, Riviera Nayarit, Mexico can bring heat. If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before GranFondo Riviera Nayarit and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for GranFondo Riviera Nayarit’s 80 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 80 miles of mixed terrain in Nuevo Vallarta, Riviera Nayarit, Mexico.
